text: {"overall_winner":"B","qualities":[{"evidence":"Clear claim in opening sentence","quality":"thesis clarity","description":"The essay states a direct position early and makes its argument easy to follow from the start."},{"evidence":"References to machine limitations and system glitches","quality":"reasoned support","description":"It backs up its position with more developed explanations of why driverless cars could fail or cause crashes."},{"evidence":"“What happens when…” and “Could easily…”","quality":"counterargument handling","description":"It acknowledges a potential benefit before turning to objections, which makes the argument feel more balanced and persuasive."},{"evidence":"“In the long run though, there are more risks than advantages”","quality":"argument organization","description":"The essay moves from claim to explanation to conclusion in a clearer, more structured way."},{"evidence":"“stick to manual cars and invest time in learning how to drive safely”","quality":"concluding call to action","description":"It ends with a specific recommendation rather than only restating fear of the topic."}]}
